title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection Malibu Collection | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Robe Hook 2.64-Inch Projection | Allied Brass
description:
Add an organized spot for robes and towels with this wall mount robe hook, crafted from brass and designed to coordinate with the Malibu collection in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Brass construction for a sturdy everyday hook
- Color-coordinated mounting hardware included
- Assembled in the USA

Specs:
- Category: Robe Hooks
- Collection: Malibu
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Overall size: 2 in L x 2 in H x 2.64 in W
- Projection: 2.64 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 0.5 lb
- Screw size: 6
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finish options to match versatile bath accessories in the Malibu collection.
